message.content:
The consensus among critics and audiences alike was that **“Nomadland”** (2020) was the standout film of the year. ### Why “Nomadland” tops the list | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Accolades** | • 2021 Academy Award for Best Picture (the first film shot entirely on a smartphone to win)
• Best Director (Chloé Zhao), Best Actress (Frances McDormand), Best Original Screenplay (Chloé Zhao & Jason Reitman) | | **Critical reception** | • Rotten Tomatoes: 94% fresh (average rating 8.5/10)
• Metacritic: 88/100 (universal acclaim) | | **Cultural impact** | • Sparked conversations about the gig economy, rural America, and the definition of “home.”
• Inspired a wave of documentaries and feature films exploring similar themes. | | **Story & performances** | • A quiet, contemplative narrative that follows Fern (McDormand) as she travels across the American West after losing her job.
• McDormand’s understated, deeply human performance earned her a second Oscar for Best Actress. | | **Technical excellence** | • Stunning cinematography by Joshua James Richards, capturing the vastness of the American landscape.
• The film’s use of natural lighting and real locations gives it an almost documentary feel while remaining a polished feature. | ### Other strong contenders from 2020 | Film | Highlights | |------|------------| | **The Father** | Oscar‑winning performance by Anthony Hopkins; a masterclass in portraying dementia. | | **Minari** | A heartfelt family drama that won the Grand Jury Prize at Sundance. | | **Soul** | Pixar’s Oscar‑winning animated film that tackles existential questions with humor and heart. | | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | A gripping courtroom drama that resonated with contemporary political tensions. | While opinions vary—some prefer the emotional depth of *The Father* or the cultural resonance of *Minari*—most critics and award bodies crowned **“Nomadland”** as the best film of 2020. If you’re looking for a film that combines critical acclaim, cultural relevance, and cinematic artistry, it’s the one to watch.
